The discussion focused on providing and integrating demographic analytics data for the Japanese market. Initially, [p1] requested information including age group percentages, male/female breakdowns, and facility counts (faiclity_num). [me] advised providing all available data.

[p1] later confirmed that daily average percentages were provided in a linked task. The data source was identified as Docomo, which supplies daily CSV files and hourly statistics for each facility. [p1] also noted having already calculated the average values for age groups and male/female breakdowns.
decisions: The demographic data integration will start sometime on Wednesday.
action_items: [me] to complete the work by tomorrow (Tuesday).
